alt_text: Painterly reconstruction of a late-18th-century print shop: a wooden hand press in the center worked by a printer pulling a long lever, a typesetter arranging small metal type at a table on the left, a young worker stacking blank printed sheets on the right, bundles of pamphlets tied with string, a candle lantern, and tall windows.
caption: AI reconstruction of a late-18th-century print shop. Study what you can see — then ask whose work and whose reading are missing from the picture.
factual_review: No readable text, no modern elements; hand press, type case, paper stacks, tied bundles, lantern, and windows plausible for a late-18th-century print shop. Press mechanism generalized; workforce shown is narrower than the real circulation network. Labeled as an AI reconstruction, never a primary source.
learning_purpose: Lesson 01, Part 2 image activity: reading circulation clues and identifying whose work and reading the image does not show
prompt: AI reconstruction illustration for a grade-9 history lesson: a late-18th-century print shop at work.
